Profile
Ciena Corporation is an American optical networking systems and software company based in Hanover, Maryland. The company reported revenues of $4.8 billion and more than 9,000 employees, as of November 2025. Gary Smith has been president and chief executive officer since 2003. Customers include AT&T, Deutsche Telekom, KT Corporation and Verizon Communications. Wikipedia
